title: AnonFund
tagline: Only way the source of crowdfunding.
description:
DisasterManagement is in no one's hands and it not only destroy the environment but also takes away lot many things from us, to help people in their tough times we came up with this where the end-user just needs to verify that they are Indian and with the help of AnonAadhaar we will try to capture their location so that the end-user doesn't rug-pull the funds for their sake, and every genuine aadhar holder who was affected receives some funds every 15 days which they can claim either in Ether,USD,ERC20 token.
